Zara (People Ops): Quick FYI everyone  orientation set for Thu 9:00 AM PT / 5:00 PM GMT. Invite sent to new-hires group. Zoom link in the event.
Mikko: Thanks Zara. Is this the one with account setup + benefits?
Zara (People Ops): Yep 3 intros, account setup walkthrough, security checklist, benefits Q&A. We'll record and add captions.
Aisha: I'm in SGT so that's late. Will you run an APAC-friendly repeat or just a recording?
Zara (People Ops): We'll host a live APAC-friendly session Fri 7:30 AM PT / Sat 11:30 PM SGT so folks can ask questions live. I'll create a second calendar event labelled "APAC-friendly".
Diego: Can you add onboarding buddy names and Slack handles to the calendar description? Super helpful.
Zara (People Ops): Done — buddy names + Slack handles and pre-read links will be in the description.
it-bot: Reminder: finish SSO & MFA before orientation to avoid delays. Guide: https://intranet.company.com/it/mfa
Mikko: Will the recording include a transcript and jump timestamps? Makes rewatching easier.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "New Hire Orientation  Main" Thu 2026-06-12 09:00:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/800111222. Recording location: https://drive.company.com/orientation-recordings.
Zara (People Ops): We'll enable Zoom auto-captions and upload a time-stamped transcript to Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/onboarding. I'll also add section timestamps in the Notion page and the calendar description.
Aisha: If someone needs an .ics for Outlook, can calendar-bot attach one?
calendar-bot: Reply with `ics me` in this thread and I'll DM you the .ics file.
Diego: Thanks. Also can we get the APAC eventlink posted here once it's live?
Zara (People Ops): Will do. I'll post the APAC invite + direct links to the recording & transcript in this thread after both sessions. DM me if you don't receive either invite.
Mikko: Appreciate it :thumbsup:
Zara (People Ops): Reminder: 2-hour heads-up email with checklist will go out. See you (or the recording)!
